question: If construction-oracle transfer survives native attention 15, how much is mediated by the complete layer-15 attention response, which individual heads mediate it, and do singleton head effects compose well enough to license a greedy combination?

admission_gate.binding: Do not execute from this prior alone. After the dependency result lands, a zero-model admission manifest must bind its SHA-256 and verify all required predictions true. If either live-route prediction fails, close this prior unrun.

searched: temporal is/was L15H5 reader, removal, response, weight-interface, and attention-15 dependency records
existing head and module mediation/reset/rescue priors and results
attention head response lattice and greedy combination runners
prior_art.known_lessons: Weight response alignment is diagnostic, not mediation. A responsive singleton can fail rescue because of bypass or interactions. Native head boundaries are hypotheses, and a greedy union is licensed only after singleton effects approximate the module effect.
prior_art.novelty: For each fixed A1/A2 construction oracle, cross upstream-off/on with the absolute response source of the entire layer-15 attention module and each of its nine heads, using the same paired live executions. This directly compares whole-module mediation, singleton mediation, and their compositional closure.

frozen_design.evaluation: Each evaluation parity uses the corresponding construction oracle trained on the opposite parity. No refit, subspace change, gain, or calibration is allowed.
frozen_design.capture: On each base batch, execute the upstream oracle off and on with native attention 15 and capture the absolute pre-c_proj layer-15 head-response tensor through every semantic-prefix position.

mediators.module: all nine layer-15 head responses together

cells.00: upstream off, mediator response from upstream-off execution
cells.01: upstream off, mediator response rescued from upstream-on execution
cells.10: upstream on, mediator response reset from upstream-off execution
cells.11: upstream on, mediator response from upstream-on execution

frozen_design.accounting: For each expert, parity, panel, mediator, and version report rowwise full upstream effect r11-r00, rescue r01-r00, reset loss r11-r10, bypass r10-r00, and Mobius interaction. Score linear margin effects against the full upstream effect; keep KL and flips as cellwise nonlinear outcomes.
frozen_design.composition_test: On each expert/parity own v15 target, compare the rowwise sum of nine singleton reset-loss vectors with the complete-module reset-loss vector. No greedy union is executed in this atlas. If the registered additive gate passes, a later parity-cross-selected greedy union is licensed; otherwise use an interaction-aware head-set test.
frozen_design.scope: The atlas identifies mediation of the fixed oracle intervention, not universal necessity for native is/was behavior. v16 is OOD_TEXT_REUSE_NEW_INTERVENTION, not pristine text holdout.

predictions.pred_a_admission_authority_capture_repla: The hash-bound admission manifest passes; cell 00 and 11 replay the admitted dependency arms; absolute self-source head/module clamps are identity within 1e-4; every rowwise decomposition closes within 1e-12; all outputs are finite and within literal price.
predictions.pred_b_complete_attention15_module_media: For both experts and parities on their own v15 target, complete-module reset loss and rescue each have signed projection >= .10 against the full upstream-live effect and direction fraction >= .75.
predictions.pred_c_l15h5_is_stable_dominant_singleto: For both experts and parities on their own v15 target, L15H5 has positive reset-loss and rescue projection and ranks in the top two of nine heads for both measures; its reset-loss direction fraction is >= .75.
predictions.pred_d_singleton_reset_losses_approximat: For both experts and parities on their own v15 target, the sum of nine singleton reset-loss vectors predicts the module reset-loss with cosine >= .90 and relative L2 error <= .25.
predictions.pred_e_l15h5_mediation_is_control_select: For every expert/parity v15 P/C panel, the L15H5 rescue and reset cells introduce no additional top-one flips relative to their own 00/11 backgrounds, and each changed-versus-background mean KL is <= .02.
predictions.pred_f_l15h5_mediation_transfers_to_v16: For both experts and parities on the own v16 target, L15H5 reset loss has signed projection >= .10 against the full upstream-live effect, direction fraction >= .75, and the reset cell adds no P top-one flip relative to cell 11.

decision.attention15_bypass: A passes and B fails: native upstream transfer exists but is not substantially mediated by the layer-15 attention response.
decision.weight_reader_rejected: A/B pass and C fails: layer-15 attention mediates, but L15H5's static weight alignment does not identify the causal singleton reader.
decision.interaction_conditioned_reader: A/B/C pass and D fails: L15H5 is a mediator, but singleton effects do not support a distributive greedy combination; use interaction-aware head sets.
decision.greedy_head_union_licensed: A/B/C/D pass: parity-cross-selected greedy head combination is licensed. E and F separately gate selective and OOD promotion.

closed_claims: semantic identity of an entire attention head
Q/K/V factor identity before a passing head-level mediation result
greedy combination before singleton composition passes
